title: Solana program audit
steps: `anchor build` / `cargo build-sbf`, then `anchor test`; read every `#[account(...)]` constraint and the win condition.
Check signer/owner checks: is `authority` a `Signer`? Is the program-owned account validated? Can an attacker pass a fake account?
Check PDA seeds/bump canonicalization and collisions; pre-create an account to make a victim `init` fail.
Check CPI: target program id, account metas, signer seeds, and whether arbitrary CPI can be induced.
Check reinit/close/rent and integer/lamport math; reproduce with a local validator test.
falsifier: All accounts are signer/owner/seed-validated and the win condition is unreachable from the attacker role.
